description: Renovate configuration for ontolint. This is the only configuration file: Renovate reads renovate.json at the root before .github/renovate.json.

schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates of the dev dependency group, and automerge them once every check on the pull request has passed
Group GitHub Actions updates. They are pinned to a commit digest (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests), so minor, patch and digest updates of actions automerge once every check has passed
The PyPI publish action runs with the release's OIDC token, so its updates get their own pull request, reviewed by hand (a group automerges only if every update in it does)
Move uv, wherever it is pinned (setup-uv inputs, UV_VERSION, the uv_build backend), in one pull request that is reviewed by hand
ROBOT Docker base images (Alpine and Distroless)
Runtime dependencies ([project.dependencies]: rdflib, pyshacl) are reviewed individually for semantic and parsing changes, and never automerge
Major updates never automerge, whatever matched them above

customManagers.description: Update the UV_VERSION environment variable in GitHub workflows (the github-actions manager already reads literal setup-uv version inputs)
